title: If Peter Parker have a dad body.. this must be it 🤣 Peter Parker is a fictional character that portrays as a photo journalist in profession but secretly doing heroic stuff and he is well known as spiderman.. fictional as it may seems, but i always admire his character doing heroic stuff without even expecting something in return and yet as Peter Parker he was always been underestimated and belittled by everybody around him. In real life, life is like that, but the most important is what you do when no one cares and no one knows. God will always see your heart and that is worth more than a billion praises from anyone else... always be humble my friends and let God be your always purpose in life, to make God happy in everything you do.
